## Step 1: Weights

"The treatment model can be defined as an association
model that ‘‘predicts’’ use of rescue medication as
some function of confounders." [@Mortimer2005]

First, calculate stabilized IPTW: "(marginal probability/conditional probability) or P(A)/P(A|W)" [@Mortimer2005]

Numerator: P(A) >> probability of exposure level
Denominator: P(A|W) >> probability of exposure level given confounders


```{r}
library(tidyverse)

schools <- read_rds(here::here(
  "a12_cps_data/2026-07-22/data/schools_analytic.rds" 
  ))
```
